name: agriwatch
description: AgriWatch — weather monitoring dashboard for field agents managing multiple parcels

scripts.setup:install: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,green,blue "pnpm -C shared install" "pnpm -C api install" "pnpm -C web install"
scripts.setup:db: pnpm -C api db:migrate && pnpm -C api db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm -C web dev" "pnpm -C api dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C api build && pnpm -C web build
scripts.test: pnpm -C shared test && pnpm -C api test && pnpm -C web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C shared typecheck && pnpm -C api typecheck && pnpm -C web typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
